title: Article III of the Bylaws: The Equity Memberships One Member May Carry at Once
content:
**Section 1.** A member carries at most 3 equity memberships under Membership and Patronage Equity at once, counting every membership that is not retired or transferred, and only 1 of them may be a voting class, because the cooperative votes one member one vote and a second voting membership would vote the same operation twice.

**Section 2.** The usual shape is a voting membership for the operation, a certificate holding for equity retained in earlier years, and where the class applies a preferred holding.

**Section 3.** A class whose entry gate calls for common stock is not opened until the stock is issued and recorded on the membership, and a class whose entry gate calls for years of membership is not opened until the member has been on the books that long, counted in whole fiscal years from the date the membership was accepted. Neither is taken from the member's recollection of when they joined, since the joining date is on their own record.

**Section 4.** Where the entry gate is not met the application is taken and waits in applied standing rather than being refused, and the qualifying business the member does in the meantime still accrues and is allocated once the membership is accepted.

## The authority for Section 3

The shares recorded on the membership and the date the membership was accepted are read from the cooperative's own record of that membership, before the class is opened, and the membership is identified by its membership number so that the stock and the joining date read belong to the membership being opened and to no other.

## Points of judgement

| The member holds | Standing of each | May a further membership be opened |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 voting membership, 1 certificate holding | both open | yes, a 3rd may be opened if it is not a voting class |
| 1 voting membership, 1 certificate holding, 1 preferred holding | all open | no, 3 are already carried |
| 1 voting membership, 2 retired memberships | 1 open, 2 retired | yes, retired memberships are not counted |
| 1 voting membership | open | a second voting class may not be opened; a non-voting class may |

**On an unmet gate.** A member of eleven months' standing applying for a class that calls for 1 whole fiscal year of membership does not have the application refused. It is taken, and it waits in applied standing; business done meanwhile accrues and is allocated once the board accepts the membership.
